integrity: The orbit invariant is proved directly by finite-dimensional linear algebra and extension of pair isomorphisms; exact counts are independently checked by exhaustive subspace/flag enumeration for small fields and dimensions.
scientific limitations: The deduction is elementary in the pure finite-field pair and may be known as folklore in the language of parabolic linear groups or lovely pairs. The independent-stratum count concerns linearly independent, not merely pairwise-distinct, tuples.
title: Generic finite-field subspaces have two-step-flag tuple orbits
